notes.title: Full Release is here!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
we have a big news for you. Today is a big day, Cartoon Strike is finally out of Early Access.

[b]What new content is added in Season 1?[/b]
[list]
[*] Lots of new skins for weapons and characters.
[*] New Farm map (remaster of the old Farm map from Cartoon Strike Online).
[*] New Prototype map.
[*] Achievements.
[*] Daily Quests.
[*] New profile system - you can now play with all skins on all maps.
[*] Party system - play with friends.
[*] New shooting system.
[*] And many more small improvements.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=4LvJxYpPc30;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Season explanation and FAQ[/b][/u]
Seasons are introduced for better understanding of our release cycles. We refer to Early Access as Season 0 (S-0 for short) and to Full Release as Season 1 (S-1). With new season comes new level up rewards, new boxes and lots of new content. 

[b]What defines Season 1?[/b]
[list]
[*] We view Season 1 as Season 0 extended with new content. So Season 1 contains all the content of Season 0 and many new additions.
[/list]
[b]How Season 1 affects level up rewards?[/b]
[list]
[*] Level progress is reset and new rewards are added. Level up to claim exclusive Pink and White Rabbit skin - mascot of Season 1! Overall level up rewards have been increased.
[/list]
[b]What is an exclusive skin?[/b]
[list]
[*] Exclusive skins can be used for all profiles: History, Present, Future. They are marked with purple color. Currently only four skins are exclusive:
[*] Chicken Man Yellow set, Chicken Man White set, Rabbit Pink set, Rabbit White set.
[/list]
[b]How Season 1 changes boxes?[/b]
[list]
[*] Boxes are renamed to include season abbreviation, e.g. Common Standard Box is now Common Standard Box S-0. Newly added box of same type is named Common Standard Box S-1.
[/list]
[b]What contains boxes from Season 1?[/b]
[list]
[*] Common Standard/History/Present/Future Box S-1: One weapon or clothes skin. Either selected from new skins or Season 0 skins.
[*] Rare Standard/History/Present/Future Box S-1: Three weapon or clothes skins. One common, one rare and one either common or rare. Each skin is selected from new skins or Season 0 skins.
[/list]
For more information about boxes consult our wiki: https://cartoonstrike.gamepedia.com/Boxes

notes.title: New Update: Improvements and optimizations
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32600979/19d28945522bba997e900499cd058ddf0767b5ef.png[/img]

[h2]Changelog - Ver. 0.0.12: Fixes and QoL changes[/h2]
-------------------------------
[b]General:[/b]
- Various updates and fixes for following maps: Menu, Tounine, Arabian Night, Streamhouses, Airport.
- Join Team rework. Once per minute a player can join the team if there is either free space or an AI.
- Team colors rework. Player’s team will always be blue and the enemy team will always be red. Even after changing teams.

[b]In Reality:[/b]
- Fixed various problems with AI.
- Walk, Run and Jump sounds effects are now correctly synchronized with player’s Walk, Run and Jump actions.
- Time between matches reduced from 60s to 30s.
- Player has 90 seconds to choose the team at the start of the match.
- Turned off shadows for players.
- Fixed bug where game broke after player changed team on Streamhouses map.
- Chat fixes.

[b]In Menu:[/b]
- Added sound when equipping clothes and changing weapon skins in Customization.

[b]Other:[/b]
- Renamed teams on Streamhouses map from Blue and Red to Omega and Alpha.
- Default clothes colors for teams Omega and Alpha are purple and green.
- Visual error on Bank Robber vest fixed.
- Fixed daily quest conversion problem.

notes.title: Khione Arena Update
notes.content:
[b]Arena Update is finally here and you can look forward to a new map, daily quests and many different improvements.[/b]


[previewyoutube=4L7RoJaYuFU;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Changelog - Ver. 0.0.11: Arena Update[/b]

-------------------------------

[u]General:[/u]
- Added Khione Arena map! Designed for fast action, spherical arena offers quick interaction between players. Battle it out to claim a spot among the best Khionian warriors. Gaining intel in the center of the map will help you. It replaces the old Planet Khione map.
- Added Daily Quests! Once per day the player gets a random quest. Finish it to claim a reward. Player can have up to three quests in progress. Once per day a quest can be reset to get a different one. There are ten unique quests.

[u]AI:[/u]
- AI can now hack security point on the Airport map.
- AI can now hack computers on the Streamhouses map.
- Various AI behavior improvements.

[u]Graphics:[/u]
- Added option to disable Post Processing in settings to improve performance on slower machines.

[u]Menu:[/u]
- Added Level Up Menu. Entered by clicking on the player's profile in top right corner, Level Up Menu shows level up rewards for each available level. The last level, codified “X”, is repeatable.
- Daily Quests are displayed on the right side of the Home screen. Click on the quest to read the description or to reset it.
- Cartoon News moved to the left side of the Home screen.
- Reward Window shows up in the Menu when the player levels up or completes a daily quests. This is a reminder of player’s achievements.
- Create Default Reality button has 30 minutes cooldown. It is intended to be used only in case of emergency when already created reality breaks.
- Tounine map image in Reality list menu and Create Custom Reality menu replaced with new one.
- Fixed problem where texts in Boxes menu did not show up in 1280 x 720 resolution. 

[u]Weapons:[/u]
- Reload time is faster by 20% for all History and Present weapons.  
- Laser Bullets: add new bullet effect and new muzzle flash effect. Bullets show small laser explosion upon impact.
- Fixed laser bullet headshot problem.

[u]Character:[/u]
- Crouch motion speed increased by 136.25%.
- Walk animation speed increased by 61%.

[u]In Reality:[/u]
- Daily Quests progress is shown at the end of the match.
- Characters shown in the Top Three Players screen are now closer to each other.

[u]Other:[/u]
- Map category is displayed in the description text in the Create Custom Reality menu, at the start of the match in the Intro Screen and in the End Game Screen.

notes.title: New update: Knives and many more
notes.content:
Changelog - Ver. 0.0.7
-----------------------
[b]Weapons:[/b]

[u]- Grenades:[/u]

	- Frag Grenade, Smoke Grenade Flashbang, Thermal Imploder:
		- Physics reworked. Grenades are now faster, heavier and have same trajectory.
		- Added trail effect.
	- Frag Grenade, Flashbang, Thermal Imploder:
		- Changed detonation time from 3 to 2 seconds.
	- Frag Grenade, Thermal Imploder, C4:
		- It is no longer possible to kill teammate.
- Fixed problem where light was not reflected on these weapons: Frag Grenade, Flashbang, Knife.
- Knife is split into three categories: History has Ka-Bar, Present has BK-7, Future has Toria Razor L1.
- Some knives can be bought from Steam Store:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/616830/detail/200076/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32600979/eabc00b8a1dd4a1391739b32ae5b09bcd64ab398.png[/img][/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/616830/detail/200072/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32600979/3d930455e328cf73317a3bed54958a2d965ce979.png[/img][/url]


[b]Skins:[/b]

- Added rarity information to the game data. Skin rarities are visible in Customization menu and Boxes menu. A skin is framed in dark grey rectangle if it is a default skin, light grey rectangle if it is a common skin, blue rectangle if it is a rare skin. Rarity color effect is shown after opening box.
- Added skins for Ka-Bar and BK-7 knives. Both can be dropped from Common Standard Box and Rare Standard Box. Ka-Bar can be dropped from  Common History Box and Rare History Box. BK-7 can be dropped from Common Present Box and Rare Present Box. Rusty Ka-Bar and Tsunami BK-7 skins can be purchased from our Steam Store.

[b]Maps:[/b]

[u]- Airport:[/u]

	- Hacking reworked: all players can now take bag through security point in the middle of the map, but when one team hack the point, the opposite team for a short time lose opportunity to go through with bag on. To support this, images showing limited access were added to the security point.
	- Fixed the issue where joining player had wrong flag captured info.
	- Fixed issue with minimap not working correctly when player entered the portal or spawned at some places.
	- Fixed issue with minimap not correspoding to the actual position on the map.
	- Fixed problem where hacking feature broke down when player died in the hacking area.
	- Added shafts near security point.

[u]- Tounine:[/u]

	- Fixed bug where player could jump into the bridge building.
	- Fixed lighting on the map. Moving objects should be visible more clearly.

[u]- Streamhouses:[/u]

	- Player can no longer jump out of the map when Change Of Gravity anomaly is on.
	- Fixed occlusion culling problems.

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.content:
[b]Changelog - Ver. 0.0.4[/b]
Weapons: 
- Lowered recoil for StG44 and MP40 by 25%. 
- Lowered spread for Tommy Gun and MP40 by 25%. 
- Fixed repeatedly played sound of dry fire on AI.
HUD:
- Weapon crosshair dimensions increased.
- Hit confirm crosshair dimensions increased. 
- Hit confirm crosshair color matches weapon crosshair color.
UI:
- Added 'Next Reward' text in the main menu next to the player level.
- Added 'Reward' text in the End of Match screen, when player reaches new level.
- Fixed bug which caused showing 'PlayerName' in the score table instead of players name.
- Fixed bug which caused not showing correct player name in the log when he joined reality.
- Background of the death screen darkened.
Global:
- Added option to create custom reality without anomalies.
- Increased anomalies cooldown. Previous: cooldown set to 15-30 seconds. Now: cooldown set to 45-60 seconds.
- Turned off camera shake after being hit.

notes.title: Hot Fix #2
notes.content:
[b]Changelog - Ver. 0.0.3[/b]
----------------------
Quick Play button:
- Changed Quick Play button behaviour. Previous: player joins reality with the most players, where number of players is lower than 12. Now: player joins randomly selected reality, where number of players is lower than 10.
Capture The Point:
- Fixed bug that caused The Point to be uncapturable.
- Fixed materials on various windows. Recomputed occlusion culling data.
AI:
- Error causing problems when joining to the team and making the game break due removal/creation of AI player when human player joined/left the reality fixed.
Characters:
- Size of head and body colliders on all players increased.
In reality:
- Match menu is now available all the time when in the reality. Previous: it was disabled during the end game and until player created his character.
- Idle player check changed. Previous: idle player is kicked after 180 seconds. Now: idle player is kicked after 90 seconds.

notes.title: Hot Fix #1
notes.content:
[b]Changelog - Ver. 0.0.2[/b]
-------------------
Global:
- Maximum number of players in reality decreased from 16 to 12
- Only 10 ai players in default realities allowed
UI:
- Text on Create Room button in Create Custom Reality screen in menu changed from 'Create Room' to 'Create Reality'
- Arrow indicating incoming damage removed, because it did not work properly
AI:
- Ai shooting accuracy decreased
- Fixed bug with clothes on ai created when player leave the reality
Weapons adjustment:
- Smoother weapon swaying while walking.
- Increased walk speed while zooming. Previous: zoom walk speed is 40% of regular walk speed. Now: zoom walk speed is 70% of regular walk speed.
- Lowered Field of View (FoV) while zooming for each primary and secondary weapon except for sniper rifles. This means player's surrounding appears closer. Sniper rifles remain unchanged. Previous: FoV set to 60 while zooming. Now: FoV set to 50 while zooming.
Other:
- Planet Khione: lowered fog density for The Mist anomaly.

[b]Leveling system:[/b]
- Level up limit increased to 5. Previous: up to 2 level ups allowed per day. Now: up to 5 level ups allowed per day.
- Increased level up rewards.

notes.title: Open Beta of Cartoon Strike is finally here!
notes.content:
Hello guys,
[b]Open beta is finally here.[/b]

[url=http://eepurl.com/dsGmOT][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32600979/39a8ce7ecd6d285ee3831abfba0fc705b045f22f.jpg[/img][/url]

You will be able to play the game from November 26 to December 3. If you do not have time, do not worry. We will have at least one more open beta test before the full release.

The main goal of this beta is to test the overall functionality of the game, especially multiplayer. For this reason, the game will have limited content compared to the final version.

[b]What can you expect?[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 maps
[*] WW map - Tounine
[*] Present map - Dirt2
[*] Future map - Planet Khione

[*] 3 game modes
[*] Arms race
[*] Free for all
[*] Team deathmatch

[*] The characters will have only basic items and the weapons will have only the default skins
[/list]

To participate in the beta, you need a Windows PC and Steam account. [url=http://eepurl.com/dsGmOT]Sign up here to and get your Steam key[/url]. The keys are distributed once a day.

Visit our [url=https://discord.gg/yCKC85g]Discord [/url]to see latest updates, get support or provide feedback of your experience.

Have a fun!
